items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got to work with Ella Fitzgerald for quite a while... I got to play with her a bit... I got to South America with Ella.

ctx.x: Were these travels mostly in the U.S.? Did you go abroad that early?

Yeah. No, not really, no. I think the first time I went to Europe… Oh, I did, actually. I think I went to Europe with Giuffre once, and then I was in Europe… Norman Granz had, was Jim Giuffre’s manager for a while. We had had a couple of other… he had had a couple other managers. And Norman Granz also managed Ella Fitzgerald. And Herb Ellis had been playing guitar with Ella and he left. I think he went with Oscar Peterson – something like that. Anyway, I got… talk about lucky. I got to work with Ella Fitzgerald…
That’s exactly the next thing I’m gonna list.
